value_stream.name: Trade-In, Buy-Back & Certified Pre-Owned Product Resale

workflows.name: Certified Pre-Owned Listing, Content & Channel Syndication

Automation Opportunity: - Listing/content automation from certification data; multi-channel syndication; availability sync
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: listings clearly "certified pre-owned" (not new) (VS-118/VS-22); availability accurate (VS-05); lifecycle managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-137 (PIM), VS-10/VS-65 (channels), VS-07/VS-13 (store/loyalty), VS-151 (auto-ID), VS-118 (integrity), W4581 (price), W4589 (certification)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misrepresentation risk**: Listed/marked as new → consumer-protection/fraud (VS-118/VS-22); mitigated by clear certified-pre-owned labeling & integrity check
- **Availability-drift risk**: Listed item sold elsewhere → cancellation (VS-13); mitigated by real-time availability sync (VS-05)
System Touchpoints: - PIM (VS-137); ecommerce (VS-10); marketplace (VS-65); stores (VS-07); loyalty (VS-13); auto-ID (VS-151); revenue assurance (VS-118)

steps.activity: Merchandising/PIM create the certified-pre-owned listing (grade, condition description, photos, certified warranty W4583, price W4581, serial), clearly marked "certified pre-owned"
Ecommerce/Marketplace syndicate the listing to channels (web VS-10, marketplace VS-65, in-store VS-07, loyalty VS-13), with accurate availability (VS-05/W4584)
Marketing/Merchandising manage listing lifecycle (refresh, de-list on sale, re-grade on aging), and ensure no misrepresentation as new (VS-118/VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - Serial/grade/price validation at checkout; distinct COGS booking; analytics capture
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: correct SKU/serial/price/grade (VS-118); warranty disclosed (W4583); COGS distinct (W4582/VS-17)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08/VS-10 (POS/ecommerce), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-17/VS-79 (finance/tax), W4581 (price), W4582 (COGS), W4584 (item-coding), W4599 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pricing-integrity risk**: Wrong price/grade/serial → revenue leakage or overcharge (VS-118); mitigated by RA verification
- **Accounting-error risk**: Pre-owned COGS mis-booked; mitigated by distinct accounting (W4584/VS-17)
System Touchpoints: - POS (VS-08); ecommerce (VS-10); revenue assurance (VS-118); finance/tax (VS-17/VS-79); CRM (VS-13); item-coding (W4584)

steps.activity: POS/Ecommerce process the certified-pre-owned order (correct SKU/serial W4584, price W4581, warranty W4583 disclosure), with pricing integrity (VS-118)
Revenue Assurance/Pricing verify price/grade/serial correctness (no new-price on pre-owned, no serial mismatch), and capture the sale for analytics (W4599)
Finance/Tax account the resale (COGS = acquisition+refurb W4582, revenue, VAT VS-79), per VS-17 distinct pre-owned accounting

Automation Opportunity: - Serial-verified pick/ship; omnichannel routing (VS-60); warranty auto-registration
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: correct serial-unit fulfilled & verified (VS-05); certificate/warranty included; warranty registered to new owner (VS-53)
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (stores), VS-05 (inventory), VS-06/VS-60 (logistics/omnichannel), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-13 (support), VS-53 (warranty), W4584 (item-coding)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-unit risk**: Different serial-unit shipped than ordered → grade/condition mismatch; mitigated by serial-verified pick
- **Warranty-registration-gap risk**: New owner not registered → claim issue (VS-53); mitigated by mandatory registration
System Touchpoints: - Stores (VS-07); inventory (VS-05); logistics (VS-06); omnichannel (VS-10/VS-60); customer support (VS-13); warranty (VS-53)

steps.activity: Stores/Inventory pick the specific certified serial-unit (VS-05/W4584), verify identity/grade before handover, and stage for pickup/ship
Logistics/Ecommerce fulfill (BOPIS pickup VS-10, or delivery VS-06/VS-60), with the correct serial-unit (not a different unit) and certificate/warranty
Customer Support/CRM confirm receipt, capture satisfaction/review (W4598), and register the warranty to the new owner (VS-53/W4583)

fields.Trigger: Customer warranty claim on certified pre-owned
fields.Volume: Warranty claims across sold pre-owned units

Automation Opportunity: - Claim-validation/registration check; root-cause capture; warranty-reserve analytics
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: claims validated per terms (W4583); root-cause fed to refurb improvement (W4591); cost reserved (W4583)
Cross-references: - links to VS-53 (warranty), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-13 (support), VS-31 (quality), VS-17 (finance), W4583 (warranty framework), W4591 (refurb improvement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Excess-claim risk**: High claim rate → margin erosion/quality issue; mitigated by root-cause & refurbishment improvement (W4591)
- **Reserve-shortfall risk**: Under-reserved warranty liability; mitigated by claim-cost tracking & reserve (W4583)
System Touchpoints: - Warranty (VS-53); service center (VS-12.1); customer support (VS-13); quality (VS-31); finance (VS-17)

steps.activity: Warranty/Customer Support validate the claim (registration VS-53, terms W4583, within warranty period), and route to service center (VS-12.1)
Service Center/Quality diagnose & resolve (repair, replace, or refund per terms), with quality root-cause (VS-31) feeding refurbishment improvement (W4591)
Finance/Warranty account the claim cost (reserve W4583), capture claim analytics (failure modes, cost), and report warranty performance (VS-53)

Automation Opportunity: - Return-validation/condition check; re-disposition routing; return analytics (W4599)
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: returns per policy (VS-32/RA 7394); condition/serial validated; re-disposition economic (W4582)
Cross-references: - links to VS-32 (returns), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-13 (support), VS-05 (inventory), VS-17 (finance), VS-125 (abuse), W4582 (economics), W4589/W4590 (re-disposition)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Return-abuse risk**: Returns used to exploit policy (VS-32/VS-125); mitigated by condition/serial validation & abuse monitoring
- **Re-disposition-cost risk**: Returned units costly to re-process; mitigated by re-disposition economics (W4582)
System Touchpoints: - Returns (VS-32); service center (VS-12.1); customer support (VS-13); inventory (VS-05); finance (VS-17); compliance (VS-22)

steps.activity: Returns/Customer Support process the pre-owned return per RA 7394/return policy (VS-32), validate condition/serial, and issue refund/exchange
Service Center/Returns re-inspect the returned unit, and re-disposition (re-certify W4589 if still gradeable, parts/recycle W4590 if not)
Finance/Inventory account the return (refund, inventory re-acquisition, any write-down), per VS-17/VS-32, and capture return analytics (W4599)

Automation Opportunity: - Review/feedback capture; trust-signal management; complaint analytics
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: transparent grade/certification; feedback actioned (VS-31/W4591); complaints fairly handled (VS-13/VS-22)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-14 (marketing), VS-44 (insights), VS-31 (quality), VS-01 (merch), VS-22 (compliance), W4591 (refurb improvement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Trust-deficit risk**: Customers distrust pre-owned quality; mitigated by transparency, certification, reviews
- **Complaint-escalation risk**: Unresolved complaints → reputation (VS-14.3); mitigated by fair complaint handling (VS-13)
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); marketing (VS-14); insights (VS-44); quality (VS-31); merchandising (VS-01); compliance (VS-22)

steps.activity: CX/Marketing manage trust signals (transparent grade/condition, reviews, certification credibility), and capture customer feedback/reviews (VS-44/VS-13)
CX/Quality act on feedback (grade/certification accuracy, refurbishment quality), routing issues to quality/refurbishment (VS-31/W4591)
CX/Compliance manage complaints fairly (VS-13/VS-22), protect brand trust, and report CX outcomes to merchandising (VS-01)

Automation Opportunity: - Valuation-accuracy model; yield/margin dashboards; lift/baseline analytics
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: performance measured vs baseline (W4577); valuation tuned on accuracy; yield/margin tracked; board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (data), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-12.1 (service center), W4577 (baseline), W4579/W4582 (valuation/yield), W4580 (lift)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Valuation-drift risk**: Valuations not tuned on outcomes → margin leak; mitigated by valuation-accuracy analytics
- **Yield-blindness risk**: Low yield unseen; mitigated by yield analytics (W4582)
System Touchpoints: - Data/BI (VS-28); finance (VS-17.4); pricing (VS-01.2); service center (VS-12.1); insights (VS-44)

steps.activity: Data/Finance measure program performance (trade-in volume, new-purchase lift W4580, refurb yield W4582, resale margin, warranty-claim rate) vs baseline (W4577)
Data/Merchandising analyze valuation accuracy (trade-in value vs realized resale W4579), category economics, and channel performance
Finance/Merchandising report portfolio intelligence to the board (VS-36), tune valuation/eligibility/pricing (W4578/W4579/W4581), and inform strategy (VS-33)

fields.Volume: Circular-economy impact & ESG reporting for the program

workflows.name: Circular-Economy Impact, ESG Reporting & Program Review

Automation Opportunity: - Circular-impact modeling; ESG-disclosure automation; dual-metric program dashboards
Controls: - CTL-697 (ensure controlled execution — Resale Listing, Fulfillment, Warranty & Analytics (PA-155.3).)
- CTL-697: circular impact conservatively measured & traceable (VS-21); greenwashing-controlled (W4527); program reviewed on dual circular+economic metrics (W4599)
Cross-references: - links to VS-25 (ESG), VS-73 (circular), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-33 (strategy), VS-36 (board), VS-21 (audit), W4527 (greenwashing), W4590 (disposal), W4599 (economics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: Overstated circular impact → reputational/regulatory (VS-152/W4527); mitigated by conservative, traceable measurement
- **Dual-misalignment risk**: Circular goal pursued at economic loss; mitigated by dual (circular+economic) review
System Touchpoints: - ESG (VS-25); circular (VS-73); finance (VS-17.4); strategy (VS-33); board (VS-36); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: ESG/Circular quantify circular-economy impact (units refurbished/resold, waste diverted W4590, material recovered, CO2e avoided vs new-manufacture), aligned to VS-25/VS-73
ESG/Sustainability report the impact in ESG/sustainability disclosure (VS-25/GRI/W4523), with data traceability (VS-21), avoiding overstatement (greenwashing VS-152/W4527)
Strategy/Merchandising/Circular review the program (circular + economic performance W4599), and decide scale/adjust/exit per strategy (VS-33), board-reported (VS-36)
